title: bug: strict-consumer dependency messages still say DONE/ARCHIVED, and decideCheckRepair's doc overclaims late-observation filtering
description:
Found by CQ-V12's whole-epic review (task-b621ddc9, worker-0e1ab990, 2026-11-01). This is text only.
- The structured readiness is correct: isDependencySatisfied, unmetDependsOn, satisfiedBlockedOnIds and dependsOnUnmet all take the consumer, and the V12b dependencyProjection fixtures pass.
- No gate is affected. The gap is latent until verified-local is enabled.

1) tools/reportBlocked.ts:499-507. heldOnEvidence lists only DONE ids, and blockResolution says "auto-unblocks … once <ids> are DONE/ARCHIVED". For a verified-local consumer, two kinds of id never unblock, and neither is described:
   - an ARCHIVED prerequisite without its delivery receipt (delivery-receipt);
   - a deleted id (prerequisite-missing).
2) None of these texts says a verified-local consumer needs retained verified delivery, or that a missing id never satisfies it:
   - tools/claimNextTask.ts:261 "(dependsOn gates WORKING claims until they are DONE/ARCHIVED)";
   - the tools/setTaskDependencies.ts:30 description and the :141-142 messages ("already DONE/ARCHIVED", "until they are DONE/ARCHIVED");
   - the tools/reportBlocked.ts tool and blockedOnTaskIds descriptions.
3) delivery/repairActivation.ts:26-32. decideCheckRepair's doc says "a late or replayed observation never acts", but only a decision carrying diagnostics is matched to the latest run (line 52).
   - A late run on the current candidate still returns none or replan.
   - This is benign: replan follows the task's plan revision, not the run, and an observation marker allows one answer per dispatch.
   - Fix the comment, not the behaviour.

Failing-test sketch: a strict consumer is blocked on an ARCHIVED prerequisite with no receipt (spy assertExecutionProfileReady as state/dependencyReadiness.strict.test.ts does). Expect blockResolution to name that id through describeUnmetDependency (…missing delivery-receipt). It does not today.
definitionOfDone: report_blocked's blockResolution names every recorded blockedOnTaskId the consumer-aware predicate withholds (DONE, ARCHIVED or missing) via describeUnmetDependency

The claim refusal, set_task_dependencies and report_blocked messages and tool descriptions state the verified-local rule (retained verified delivery; a missing prerequisite never satisfies) while legacy/observe wording stays accurate
decideCheckRepair's doc comment matches its actual filter; cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test passes

implementationPlan.description:
report_blocked wording, in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/reportBlocked.ts (DoD 1 and 2). This is text only: no status, code, recorded id or wire field changes.

- Decide the consumer once: `const strict = (() => { try { return isVerifiedLocal(state, task); } catch { return true; } })();`, with isVerifiedLocal imported from ../delivery/policy.js. That is the same test as dependencyUnblock.ts isStrictConsumer. Error handling: a malformed settings.executionProfile throws in resolveExecutionProfile; the predicate then fails closed and withholds every prerequisite, so the strict wording is the accurate one.
- heldOnEvidence (~:499): widen the filter from `status === 'DONE'` to an id whose status is DONE, ARCHIVED or missing (no task) and that `!isDependencySatisfied(state, id, task)`. For a legacy/observe consumer, ARCHIVED and missing ids are always satisfied, so its output is unchanged.
- blockResolution (~:502-507): when !strict, keep today's text BYTE-IDENTICAL (state/dependencyUnblock.test.ts:830 pins it word for word). When strict: `It auto-unblocks (returning unassigned, claimable by anyone) once <ids> have retained verified delivery: this task runs verified-local, so DONE or ARCHIVED alone does not satisfy it, and a missing prerequisite never satisfies it.` Then, when any are held: ` Still withheld: <ids each through describeUnmetDependency(state, id, task)>.`
- The dependenciesSatisfied message (~:272): keep today's text when !strict; when strict, say `Every selected prerequisite (<ids>) already has retained verified delivery - there is nothing to wait on, ...` with the rest of the sentence unchanged.
- The tool description (:39) and the blockedOnTaskIds description (:52): after each 'DONE/ARCHIVED' rule, add `; a verified-local task needs each one's retained verified delivery instead, and a missing id never satisfies it`. Keep every other word. Never mention git: util/daemonGitDocs.test.ts scans tool descriptions.

Claim refusal wording, in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/claimNextTask.ts and packages/moe-daemon/src/util/claimGuards.ts (DoD 2).

- claimNextTask.ts ~:255-268, the dependency refusal: compute `strict` exactly as in step 1. When !strict, keep the NOT_ALLOWED text byte-identical (dependencyUnblock.test.ts:711 and :729 pin it). When strict, replace the parenthesis with `(a verified-local task's dependsOn gates WORKING claims until each prerequisite has retained verified delivery, not merely DONE/ARCHIVED, and a missing prerequisite never satisfies it)`, keeping the rest. Pass `verifiedLocal: strict` into the dependencyEvidenceRefusal ref.
- util/claimGuards.ts dependencyEvidenceRefusal (:214): add an OPTIONAL `verifiedLocal?: boolean` to DependencyEvidenceRef. When it is true, the message says `... is DONE but lacks the retained verified delivery a verified-local task requires: <named>. dependsOn withholds WORKING claims until that evidence is recorded; ...` (the rest unchanged). When it is absent or false, the text stays byte-identical; dependencyUnblock.test.ts:697 pins it. Code, codeName and context stay unchanged.
- claimNextTask.ts tool description (:326): after 'WORKING claims are withheld until every dependsOn task is DONE/ARCHIVED', add `(a verified-local task needs each one's retained verified delivery instead, and a missing id never satisfies it)`. Never mention git.
- Edit with the Edit tool only. This task dependsOn 4e2f2b45, which edits claimNextTask.ts first, so apply the change to its landed lines.

set_task_dependencies wording, in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/setTaskDependencies.ts (DoD 2).
- The description (:30): after 'until every listed task is DONE/ARCHIVED', add `(a verified-local task needs each one's retained verified delivery instead, and a missing id never satisfies it)`.
- The messages (:139-142): compute `strict` from the UPDATED task, as in step 1, with the same try/catch error handling. When !strict, keep all three texts byte-identical. When strict:
  - satisfied: `Dependencies <verb> on <id>; all <n> already have retained verified delivery - the task is claimable now.`
  - unmet: `Dependencies <verb> on <id>; <n> unmet (<ids>) - WORKING claims stay gated until each has retained verified delivery (a missing prerequisite never satisfies a verified-local task).`
  - The 'cleared' message is unchanged.
- No other change. unmetDependsOn is already consumer-aware.

Fix the decideCheckRepair doc comment in packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/repairActivation.ts (:26-32; DoD 3). Comment only; the code stays byte-identical.

State what the filter actually does:
- It returns null when the run has no recorded dispatch or task, is not authenticated, belongs to a task that is not verified-local, or is on a candidate that is not the task's latest.
- On the latest candidate, a decision that carries diagnostics acts only for the run it names (`diagnostics.checkRunId === run.id`, line ~52).
- A decision without diagnostics (none or replan) is returned even for a late or replayed run on that candidate. That is benign:
  - replan follows the task's plan revision, not the run;
  - tools/recordCheckObservation.ts activateRepair applies a decision only when the observation is not a duplicate, so a replay is never re-applied.
- Before citing any one-observation-per-dispatch rule, check it in state/checkObservationStore.ts. Cite only what the code does.
- Keep the existing sentence about a malformed setting, snapshot or stored revision throwing INVALID_INPUT.

Tests in packages/moe-daemon/src/state/dependencyReadiness.strict.test.ts. Reuse its strict fixture: task-consumer with the STRICT snapshot, task-1 DONE with candidate + pass + review, the readiness mock, deleteTaskTool and receipt(). Use exact strings or stringContaining on the new phrases; never just truthiness. Add these rows:
- R1 (the description's failing sketch): task-1 ARCHIVED with no receipt; report_blocked on the consumer with blockedOnTaskIds ['task-1']. blockResolution contains 'task-1 [ARCHIVED, missing delivery-receipt]' and 'retained verified delivery', and does NOT contain 'once task-1 are DONE/ARCHIVED.'. It fails before step 1.
- R2: a stored, since-deleted id. Set the consumer BLOCKED with blockedOnTaskIds ['task-1','task-gone'] directly, as the existing :170 case does, with task-gone absent. A repeat report_blocked (blockedOnTaskIds []) names 'task-gone [missing, missing prerequisite-missing]'.
- R3: with task-1 DONE and verified (the beforeEach state is satisfied), report_blocked naming it answers dependenciesSatisfied:true with a message containing 'already has retained verified delivery'.
- C1: extend the 'claim names %s proof without calling it DONE' rows (or add an it.each beside them). The refusal reason also contains 'retained verified delivery' and 'a missing prerequisite never satisfies it', and lacks '(dependsOn gates WORKING claims until they are DONE/ARCHIVED)'.
- C2: in 'explicit claim refuses DONE without approval', the message contains 'retained verified delivery a verified-local task requires' and lacks 'settings.deliveryPolicy requires'.
- S1: set_task_dependencies on the consumer, run as an architect seat as :216 does. Adding an unmet id (task-1 ARCHIVED, no receipt) gives a message with 'until each has retained verified delivery'; once task-1 is satisfied, the message has 'already have retained verified delivery'.
- D1: the descriptions of claim_next_task, set_task_dependencies and report_blocked, plus report_blocked's blockedOnTaskIds property, each contain 'retained verified delivery' and 'never satisfies it'.
Do NOT edit state/dependencyUnblock.test.ts or tools/reportBlocked.test.ts. Their unchanged exact-text rows are the proof that legacy/observe wording is byte-identical (DoD 2).

Verification (DoD 3), run once on the final bytes in a git-archive snapshot. Never run npm in the shared checkout (global rail). This is the complete_task verification command:

cd /mnt/d/projexts/moes && S=$(mktemp -d /tmp/moe-7aa6be67-XXXXXX) && git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$S" && cp --parents packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/reportBlocked.ts packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/claimNextTask.ts packages/moe-daemon/src/util/claimGuards.ts packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/setTaskDependencies.ts packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/repairActivation.ts packages/moe-daemon/src/state/dependencyReadiness.strict.test.ts "$S" && cd "$S/packages/moe-daemon" && env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" sh -c 'npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test'

- Overlay ONLY these six paths: the checkout holds other sessions' dirty files, for example the untracked delivery/readinessHolder.ts.
- env -i keeps a seat's MOE_* env out of vitest (mem:gotcha-qa-session-env-and-signals-leak-into-harness).

- If a pre-existing test fails, A/B it against a pure `git archive HEAD` snapshot before blaming this change.
- Also confirm that `git diff --stat HEAD` for this task lists exactly the six paths.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- Unified wording appended to every message for all consumers: rejected. It churns legacy text that dependencyUnblock.test.ts pins 'word for word' (:697, :711, :729, :830), and legacy users gain no accuracy.
- Chosen: branch dynamic messages on the consumer's profile (isVerifiedLocal; a throw counts as strict) and unify only the static tool descriptions.
- Routing the strict DONE-without-proof case through NOT_ALLOWED instead of DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE_MISSING: rejected. It would change the wire codeName, and the task is text only.
- Exporting dependencyUnblock.ts's isStrictConsumer: rejected. delivery/policy.ts already exports the same test as isVerifiedLocal, and claimNextTask already imports policy.js.
- Dropping util/claimGuards.ts to stay at 5 files (and the standard tier): rejected. A strict consumer's evidence refusal would still blame settings.deliveryPolicy for verified-local proof, which DoD 2 ('the claim refusal') covers.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- dependencyShortfall (state/dependencyUnblock.ts:58) gives legacy/observe consumers 'gone or ARCHIVED satisfies, DONE judged by evaluateDeliveryEvidence'.
- strictShortfall (~:72) requires, even from ARCHIVED, a verified-local snapshot, an approved review on the latest candidate, a delivery receipt when ARCHIVED, and the policy evidence; a missing id gives prerequisite-missing.
- describeUnmetDependency (:291) renders `id [STATUS, missing tokens]`.
- reportBlocked.ts keeps a missing stored id recorded (the getTask guard at ~:235). Its heldOnEvidence today only looks at DONE.
- dependencyEvidenceRefusal (util/claimGuards.ts:214) has only one caller, claimNextTask.ts:265.
- activateRepair (tools/recordCheckObservation.ts:73) judges every observation but applies only non-duplicates.
- dependencyReadiness.strict.test.ts already mocks readiness and imports reportBlockedTool, claimNextTaskTool, setTaskDependenciesTool and deleteTaskTool.
- planSizeFloor (util/routing.ts:148) makes any plan with more than 5 distinct files heavy.
